Class RabbitNodeRouter

All Implemented Interfaces:
NodeRouter, org.springframework.context.Lifecycle, org.springframework.context.Phased, org.springframework.context.SmartLifecycle
@Internal public final class RabbitNodeRouter extends Object implements NodeRouter, org.springframework.context.SmartLifecycle
